methodology.data: Six previously reviewed Chinese/Zhuyin answer pages paired with genuine blank originals. Native, 900px and 1500px sizes are variants of the same sources. The English regression uses ten previously reviewed sources at three sizes.
methodology.metrics: Sparse registered ink pixels only: selected = labeled handwriting inside the erase mask; damaged = labeled print inside the erase mask. An annotated pixel is counted once per case. Counts are not whole-page or blind-test accuracy.

settings.wholePage: Chinese/Zhuyin, 96%, print protection, two-pixel growth, texture repair
settings.boxes: Preset sparse answer rectangles on each page, pencil at 70%, print protection and two-pixel growth. Rectangles are mapped by relative coordinates for blank controls. Masks are combined with that release’s whole-page result.

methodology.change: Keep all three deployed weight files. Reinforce near-threshold gray strokes supported by segmentation and the Chinese classifier. Protect regularly dashed vertical rulings. Supplement higher-pressure pencil inside explicit Chinese pencil boxes.

rejected.model: Trained a 48-feature experimental classifier. At the default 96% on native development page 45, labeled handwriting selected fell from 3,754 to 2,399 and labeled print selected rose from 21 to 128. It is excluded from the release.
rejected.geometry: Broad diagonal expansion selected printed details on the blank controls.

editor.compare: Mouse capture, touch release/cancellation, keyboard release/Escape and window blur restore the prior image or mask. A shortcut selects the next tool; earlier edits and global threshold persist.
editor.savedDraft: Existing revision 3 caches retain their saved output; explicit reanalysis uses the new recognition while retaining manual edits.

limitations: Source pages and labels have been inspected during development. Thin overlaps, solid dark connections and unlabelled print still need review. Lowering the threshold may increase print selection.
Some larger-size and blank variants select more print. Native page 39 selects slightly less handwriting.
Touch was checked in Chromium emulation. Physical phone performance and other textbooks were not measured.
